reconstruction_vs_reference.note: rel_l2 = ||reconstructed - reference|| / ||reference|| in fp64. A WRONG codebook or unpack gives cosine near 0; these values are the expected trellis reconstruction error at the stated bit rate.

tier_bitmap_crosscheck.note: producer_k and producer_expert_rel_rt_mse come from the encoder's own tier_bitmap.json. ours_bits is trellis.shape[-1] // 16 read off the payload; ours_rel_mse is (||reconstructed - reference|| / ||reference||)^2 in fp64. A ratio near 1.0 means our decode reproduces the reconstruction error the quantizer itself recorded. The residual gap is expected: the encoder scored against its fp32 source, we score against the bf16 export.
